The Lantern Room is a fictional independent listening room in Ottawa. It imagines a space where local artists can play an honest set and audiences can hear every note.

What we book

Small jazz ensembles, acoustic songwriters and emerging acts from across the Ottawa–Gatineau region. Our fictional program mixes evening sets with daytime matinees.

What to expect

Unassigned seating, a room designed for attentive listening, and enough time between sets to meet the artists.
